text: DIEMS stands for Deogiri Institute of Engineering and Management Studies. It is an autonomous institute established in 2009 and is located at Deogiri Campus, Near Hotel VITS, Railway Station Road, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra, India - 431005. The institute is managed by Marathwada Shikshan Prasarak Mandal. The official website identifies the institute as approved by AICTE, UGC, DTE and the Government of Maharashtra. B.Tech and M.Tech programmes are affiliated to Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University, Lonere, and MBA is affiliated to Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Marathwada University, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar.

The general DIEMS contact telephone number is 0240-2367576. The official-purpose email address is registrar@dietms.org. The college address is Deogiri Institute of Engineering and Management Studies, Deogiri Campus, Near Hotel VITS, Railway Station Road, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (formerly Aurangabad), Maharashtra, India - 431005. For first-year B.Tech admission enquiries, the official First Year Engineering page lists 0240-2367555, 0240-2367575 and +91-9850551980, and the email btech_admission@dietms.org.

According to the DIEMS First Year Engineering page, the undergraduate engineering programmes and listed intakes are: Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning), intake 60; Computer Science and Engineering, intake 180; Civil Engineering, intake 120; Electronics and Telecommunications Engineering, intake 120; Mechanical Engineering, intake 120; Electrical Engineering, intake 60; and Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Data Science, intake 60. The page lists DTE Code 02114. Confirm current approved intake and admission availability from the latest official notice before making a decision.

The DIEMS First Year Engineering page states that a B.Tech candidate should have passed HSC or an equivalent examination with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects, along with one of Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, Technical Vocational subject, Electronics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Informatics Practices, Agriculture, Engineering Graphics or Business Studies. The page states at least 45% marks in the above subjects taken together, or at least 40% for Backward Class categories, Economically Weaker Section and Persons with Disability candidates belonging to Maharashtra State. The page also states that candidates should have appeared in all subjects in MHT-CET (PCM) 2026 and obtained a non-zero score, or have appeared in JEE Main 2026. Admission rules can change; applicants must verify the current CET Cell and DIEMS admission notices.

The DIEMS First Year Engineering page lists these common documents for all candidates: SSC Mark Sheet; SSC Certificate; HSC/Diploma Mark Sheet; HSC Leaving Certificate (TC); MHT-CET 2026 (PCM) or JEE Main 2026 Score Card; Certificate of Age, Nationality and Domicile, or Birth Certificate or Leaving Certificate showing place of birth in Maharashtra; and passport-size photograph. The page also advises candidates to keep photocopies of original documents and soft copies in PDF format. Category-specific documents may additionally be required.

The DIEMS First Year Engineering page lists additional documents depending on category. EBC or TFWS: income certificate stating that the parent's income is less than Rs. 8 lakh. EWS: eligibility certificate for Economically Weaker Section in the CET Cell prescribed format. OBC, NT, SBC, SEBC or DTVJ: caste certificate, caste validity certificate and non-creamy layer certificate. SC or ST: caste certificate and caste validity certificate. Defence Personnel Ward: defence service certificate and domicile certificate of father or mother. Person with Disability: certificate mentioning percentage of disability not less than 40%. Applicants should confirm the latest document checklist with the current admission notice.

The DIEMS Hostels page states that hostel facilities are available on campus and off campus for boys and girls. The page lists a capacity of 200 for girls and 152 for boys. It states that facilities include both AC and non-AC rooms, with attached bathrooms in some rooms and common bathrooms in others. Hostel facilities are limited and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. For further details, the page advises contacting admin@dietms.org or the administrative offices. The chatbot must not claim that a room is currently available; applicants should confirm availability and charges with the college.

DIEMS provides fee notices and fee structure documents through its official admission pages. The exact fee amount depends on the admission route and applicable category. Do not provide a fee figure unless the corresponding current official fee notice has been added to the knowledge base and its academic year, admission route and category are clear. For current fee details, refer to the official DIEMS admission page or contact the admission office.
